Name: (CP) Vanillaish Shane (Genderbent Shane)
Author: Hitme11
Description:
Portraits for your depressive daddy-now-become-a-girl Shane, but in vanilla-friendly style to play with other portraits mod. Doesn't contain her sprites or change her name in-game. I made this because her current genderbent portraits and sprites didn't suit my tastes. Still working on sprites, but I got sidetracked.

[b]INSTRUCTION:[/b]
- Put [CP] Vanillaish Shane into your mod folder.
﻿- That's it!

[b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url]: tested.
﻿- Other mod that change Shane portraits: depends on what mod load first, if you use any mod that have configurations like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV[/url], I recommend to turn off Shane changes in those mod.

[b]PERMISSIONS[/b]: I don't block any of this mod content from modification. Feel free to use any of my content in your mod or upload your modification version on Nexus, credit me if you want.
